run_sst_classification: run SST sentiment classification with binary or fine-grained labels using SSTEval
create_sst_eval_instance: create an SSTEval instance for binary or 5-class sentiment classification on a given task path
load_sst_data: load SST sentiment data from train, dev, and test files into structured X and y arrays
prepare_sst_embeddings: prepare SST samples for embedding computation across all splits
run_sst_split_classifier: run the SplitClassifier on SST embeddings to compute dev and test accuracy
